text: One of the fine lamina isimmorable, and faltered the fewralferesys the other lides by menas of a dented wheel, which takes into the teeth that are on the furties of the laminain. This fitting lamin makes the phanchet runs in flash a mansmy that it remains damaged on the edge, when it has made one turn. Only crown and half-croony pieces can lay the im- prefinion of letters on the thickets of their edges.
